task: Write a compelling pitch for Ouroboros - Adverse Drug Events recognition software using advanced NLP and ML

examples.output: Ouroboros detects adverse drug events (ADEs) in clinical data using advanced NLP, preventing harmful drug interactions before they occur. It monitors real-time patient data to flag potential issues that human reviewers might miss.

Healthcare providers (hospitals, clinics), pharmaceutical companies conducting drug trials, and regulatory agencies (FDA, EMA) who need real-time monitoring of drug safety across large patient populations.

Real-time monitoring with 95% accuracy, seamless EHR integration, and AI-powered pattern recognition that learns from every case. Unlike competitors, we combine deep learning with clinical knowledge graphs for context-aware detection.

SaaS subscription model: $5K/month for individual hospitals (up to 500 beds), $50K/year enterprise licenses for pharmaceutical companies, with volume discounts for health systems. ROI is typically 6-12 months through reduced adverse events and liability.
3 pilot hospitals processing 50K patient records, 200+ ADEs detected in first 6 months (15 critical), partnership discussions with 2 major EHR vendors, and $500K in pipeline for next quarter.

Our NLP models are trained on 10M+ clinical notes, we have exclusive partnerships with 3 academic medical centers for data access, and our team includes 2 MDs + 3 ML PhDs who understand both medicine and AI deeply.

Adverse drug events cost the US healthcare system $30B annually. Our TAM is $5B (drug safety software market), SAM is $500M (AI-powered ADE detection), and SOM is $50M (hospitals with >200 beds in US) for year 1.

We're building the standard for AI-powered drug safety monitoring globally. In 5 years, every hospital will use Ouroboros to protect patients, and every new drug will be monitored by our platform from day 1 of clinical trials.
